description: Creates a project in an organization, with its monthly budget (€20 by default); deploy_app then deploys an app to it.

budget_eur.description: Euros per month (20 by default; 0, no cap, or more than €20: admins); alert at 80% then 100%.

name.description: The display name (the project name by default).

organization.description: The organization that holds it (the token's by default).

project.description: The project name (lowercase letters, digits, hyphens).

trial.description: The key returned by the call that created the trial (deploy_app, upload_source or write_files: trial_key), passed again on each call.

name: create_project
title: Create a project
